item.title: Gas request spikes in a few states after pipeline hack
item.description: New York (CNN Business)A developing number of corner stores along the East Coast are without fuel as anxious drivers forcefully top off their tanks following a ransomware assault that shut down the Colonial Pipeline, a basic vein for gas. The frenzy purchasing takes steps to compound the stock stun.
